title: Interpretable Multi Labeled Bengali Toxic Comments Classification using Deep Learning
findings: The best performing multi-label model (CNN-BiLSTM with Attention) was highly effective at identifying religiously toxic comments. For the 'religious' class, it achieved an accuracy of 97.48%, precision of 0.92, recall of 0.93, and an F1-score of 0.93. The area under the ROC curve for this class was 0.97, indicating strong classification performance.
